subject.title: fix(mattermost): preserve text-block boundaries in draft preview (#87322)

question: Should Mattermost block modes intentionally rotate completed text and tool blocks into multiple visible posts, and should the additive shared draft-loop, reply-pipeline, and callback-order surfaces become supported contracts?
rationale: Source, tests, and live-path proof support code correctness, but the user-visible delivery semantics and long-lived shared API ownership require explicit maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept current design
options.body: Keep multi-post Mattermost block delivery and the additive optional shared contracts, then merge after exact-head gates.

options.title: Narrow shared contracts
options.body: Preserve the Mattermost behavior but internalize or remove shared additions that maintainers do not want to support.

options.title: Retain single-post delivery
options.body: Redesign block mode to preserve accumulated content in one post rather than rotating visible posts.

recommendation.title: Accept current design
recommendation.body: Keep multi-post Mattermost block delivery and the additive optional shared contracts, then merge after exact-head gates.

likelyOwner.reason: The assigned branch adopter authored the current contract-shaping implementation and is best positioned to confirm the intended product and API direction.
